settings.headline: Built on AMD EPYC. Backed by HPE. Stocked by Platinum Micro.
settings.body: HPE ProLiant Gen11 servers with 5th Gen AMD EPYC™ 9005 processors — up to 192 "Zen 5" cores per socket, 3 TB of DDR5-6400, PCIe Gen5 across the board, AMD Secure Processor at the silicon root of trust.

settings.title: Authorized HPE distribution. Direct from Sylmar, CA.
settings.body: Two decades stocking HPE. NASPO-aligned pricing, Net-30 terms on approved application, named account managers — no auction-house pricing theater. Real inventory, real lead times, written quotes.

settings.headline: Intel inside. Every socket, every generation, on the shelf.
settings.body: 228 Intel-side SKUs in stock — Core desktop CPUs, NUC barebones and chassis, Xeon-compatible thermal kits spanning LGA 1150 / 1155 / 1156 / 1366 / 2011-3 / 1700 / 4677. From legacy refresh builds to current platforms, the parts ship the day you order.

settings.title: Components, coolers, complete builds — Intel-side, both sides of the rack.
settings.body: Intel Core retail processors, NUC chassis from Streacom, and a deep cooler bench from Arctic, Dynatron, Noctua, Scythe, and GELID — every socket Intel has shipped in the last decade. If your spec calls it out, we probably stock it.

settings.headline: Ryzen. Radeon. AM4 to SP6. Real availability.
settings.body: 86 AMD-side SKUs across processors, graphics-grade storage, and the thermal solutions that keep them quiet — Ryzen retail CPUs, Radeon-branded SSDs, plus coolers covering AM2 / AM3 / AM4 / AM5 sockets from Arctic, Dynatron, and Scythe.

settings.title: AMD silicon plus the supporting cast.
settings.body: From Ryzen workstation CPUs to Radeon-branded SSDs to AM4/AM5-compatible thermal kits — the parts that turn a spec sheet into a working machine. Quote it, configure it, or buy off-the-shelf.
